move: phones slide in from left, bottom, right, straighten, float, slide out
how: Three 240x490 phones in a row over two blurred pastel blobs. The left phone from()s x -900 with rotate -14 and rotateY 30, the middle from y 800 with rotate 6, the right from x 900 with rotate 14 / rotateY -30, each 1.0s expo.out staggered 0.15s from 3% of the 5s; a two-line headline rises from yPercent 110 (expo.out) and a tag fades in from x 20. Once settled each phone floats y -14 / 12 / -10 with 1.4s sine.inOut yoyo out of phase, and the blobs breathe scale 1 -> 1.15 yoyo over 2.5s. At 86% each phone leaves the way it came with 0.5s expo.in (0.08s stagger), the headline lines exit upward to yPercent -110 and the tag fades.
adapt: Replace the three theme pairs and screen names (or real screenshots), the headline words, the tag and the blob colours. Keep the 1.0s expo.out entries with 0.15s stagger and the mirrored 0.5s expo.in exits.
port: mount(el, shot) builds the blobs, caption and the row of three phones from shot.screens; animate(el, shot, D) returns the timeline with entries at 0.03D/0.06D/0.09D, floats from 0.24D and exits at 0.86D-0.89D. All the from() tweens should become fromTo with immediateRender:false so seeking is deterministic; el needs perspective:1800px.
caveats: two 600-700px blobs with filter blur(70px) are slow to render
loop closes only in that the frame is empty at both ends (phones off-screen, headline hidden)
